premises.text: Video creators struggle to find music: stock search is slow, tracks are expensive, copyright/royalties are confusing, tracks need manual editing to fit, and reused tracks reduce uniqueness
Patent-pending AI software writes original music note-by-note from music-theory rules and automatically produces it to a professional standard
The system yields unlimited unique, royalty-free, length-and-style-customizable tracks far cheaper than stock alternatives
premises.evidence_span: unlimited amount of unique music in a variety of styles that's completely royalty-free, instantly customizable, and far cheaper than the alternatives

premises.text: Users pay at download—five free tracks monthly then about $7 per additional track—and technology can later be licensed to platforms that supply music to their users
premises.evidence_span: Users pay at point of download

domains.name: AI composer and track output package

value.text: Unique, fitting, royalty-free music for video that is cheap and controllable by the creator
value.evidence_span: completely royalty-free, instantly customizable, and far cheaper than the alternatives

causal_links.evidence_span: writes original music completely on its own
This is about 80% cheaper than what you'd pay elsewhere
